indicators.definition: First OneMap TRANSIT-query itinerary duration at the frozen departure to reviewed NUS AS8 destination
indicators.limitation: May include walking-only journeys; itinerary duration can omit initial scheduling wait after the requested departure. The maxWalkDistance request is not a guaranteed hard walking limit.
indicators.missing: Unknown on pending, no-route or technical failure; never zero-imputed

indicators.limitation: Not network walk time; operational status needs review

indicators.definition: Unique delivered bus-stop IDs within inclusive Euclidean radius
indicators.limitation: Not route, frequency or capacity supply

indicators.definition: Standardized complete service addresses within inclusive Euclidean radius
indicators.limitation: Licences mapped to address units; ambiguous addresses flagged
Not seats, opening hours or network walk time

indicators.definition: Standardized clinic service addresses within inclusive Euclidean radius
indicators.limitation: Not care quality, affordability or student suitability

indicators.definition: Distance to included park polygons; zero inside; N_RESERVE=1 excluded
indicators.limitation: Provisional category list; not entrance, legal access or opening status

normalization: Baseline A P5/P95, clipped to 0..1 and cost-reversed; no silent constant-column handling
parameter_basis: Approved working hypotheses, not behavior-calibrated optimum parameters
